ticket.title: Add the storypole wire domain (TaskNode, TaskPlan, LedgerEvent) to gaugeblock-contracts

verification_receipt.summary: Merged to common main (fcc0d7b): gaugeblock-contracts now carries the full storypole domain — StorypoleConfig, WorkspaceConfig, DiscoveredMember, TaskNode, TaskKind, TaskStatus, TaskScope, TaskEdge, EdgeKind, TaskDecision, DecisionStatus, TaskPlan, PlanStep, AgentClaim, HandoffPacket, VerificationReceipt, TaskContextBriefing and LedgerEvent (13 variants, tagged on 'event') — split across storypole/{mod,task,continuity,events}.rs, every file <=194 lines. uuid added as a direct dependency so ids are typed. Gates: fmt OK, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest --workspace 19/19 (6 new wire tests), chalkline docs check -d common 9/9, workspace 12 targets / 0 drifted. Contract surface is now complete for GB-143 repointing.
